subject: mathematics
question_text: If A = {1, 2, 3, 4} and f: A→R is a function defined by f(x) = (x² − x + 1)/(x + 1), find the range of f.

mark_split.label: The range written as a set

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IA (2026-27 edition), book p.9, chapter 2 FUNCTIONS, Very Short Answer question 3. Only the question was taken. The solution, the step order and the mark split are this answer book's own work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. ⚠ THE MARK SPLIT IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S: the Mathematics-IA volume prints no per-step mark allocation on any answer. The 1+1 shape gives one mark to the four images and one to collecting them into the range set, because those are the two things a student can leave out. Paper position: Maths-1A Section A runs Q1–Q10 at 2 marks each, all compulsory. recall_prompt: Say how you would find the range here — what you work out, and what the answer has to look like.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Work out all four images
steps.margin_note: First mark is the four values. All four must be on the page. The rule is undefined at x = −1, but −1 is not in A, so f is defined at every element of A.
steps.memory_tip: A finite domain means no algebra. Four elements, four substitutions, one line each.

recall.must_convey: That each element of A is substituted, giving 1/2, 1, 7/4 and 13/5.
accept: substitute one two three and four and get half one seven by four and thirteen by five
f of one is a half f of two is one f of three is seven fourths f of four is thirteen fifths
put every element of A into the rule and work out the four values
nalugu values substitute chesi half one seven by four thirteen by five vasthai
the four images are one half one seven over four and thirteen over five

steps.why: A is a finite set, so the range is nothing more than the list of images. There is no inequality to solve and nothing to cancel — x² − x + 1 has no factor (x + 1), so the fraction does not reduce. The rule has no value at x = −1, and that is safe here only because −1 is not in A.
common_mistakes: Trying to cancel (x + 1) into the numerator; x² − x + 1 has no such factor.
Dropping the denominator, so f(2) is written as 3 instead of 1.
Sign slip in the numerator, writing f(3) as (9 + 3 + 1)/4.

steps.label: Collect the images into the range
steps.margin_note: Second mark is the set. Write it in braces. The four values are all different, so all four stay.
steps.memory_tip: Range means the outputs, not the inputs. Put the four values inside one pair of braces.
lines: The range is the set of all images of A.
The four values are all different.

recall.must_convey: That the range is the set of the four images, {1/2, 1, 7/4, 13/5}.
accept: the range is the set one half one seven by four and thirteen by five
collect the four images into a set and that is the range
range means the images so write them in braces
range ante images kabatti nalugu values ni set la rasthanu
the answer is the set of those four values

steps.why: The range of a function on a finite domain is exactly the set of its images. The answer has to be written as a set, not as four loose numbers, because a range is a set.
common_mistakes: Giving the domain A, or the whole of R, as the range.
Rounding 13/5 to 2.6; the exact fractions are the answer.
Writing the four values without braces, so no set is named.
